detailed_descriptions.en: Classic IGS arcade games come to Steam! Enjoy 8 beloved IGS arcade classics in one collection, including the legendary Knights of Valour series. Supports online multiplayer for up to 4 players. Relive the golden age of arcade gaming with a carefully selected collection of 8 classic IGS titles. The collection includes three games from the "Knights of Valour" series with support for up to 4-player online multiplayer, along with hidden gems such as "Martial Masters" and "Demon Front". Authentic arcade experience Faithfully recreated from the original arcade releases, these classic titles preserve the gameplay and atmosphere you remember from the arcade. Experience these timeless games on Steam and relive the excitement of the arcade era. Online & Local Multiplayer Depending on the title, enjoy online or local multiplayer with up to four players. Team up with friends and fight your way through each adventure together. Modern Quality-of-Life Features A variety of convenient features make the games accessible to both newcomers and veteran players. Difficulty options, cheat functions, and save/load anywhere allow you to jump back into the action whenever you like. Additional features include built-in move lists, one-button special move shortcuts, and fully customizable key mapping, making every game easier and more comfortable to play. Multiple Display Modes Choose from a variety of display options, from classic arcade-style screen filters to crisp high-definition visuals, and enjoy the games in the style you prefer. ※ Language can be selected from the main menu, allowing you to play each title in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, or Korean. Included Games 《Knights of Valour: Super Heroes》 《Knights of Valour Plus》 《Knights of Valour 2 - Nine Dragons》 《Oriental Legend》 《Oriental Legend Spooky》 ※《Oriental Legend》 / 《Oriental Legend Spooky》 does not support Japanese language in-game. ※《Oriental Legend》 does not support Korean language in-game. 《Martial Masters》 《Demon Front》 《The Gladiator》 ※ The Japanese version of 《The Gladiator》 does not include background music.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Classic IGS arcade games come to Steam!

Enjoy 8 beloved IGS arcade classics in one collection, including the legendary Knights of Valour series. Supports online multiplayer for up to 4 players.

Relive the golden age of arcade gaming with a carefully selected collection of 8 classic IGS titles. The collection includes three games from the "Knights of Valour" series with support for up to 4-player online multiplayer, along with hidden gems such as "Martial Masters" and "Demon Front".

Authentic arcade experience

Faithfully recreated from the original arcade releases, these classic titles preserve the gameplay and atmosphere you remember from the arcade. Experience these timeless games on Steam and relive the excitement of the arcade era.

Online & Local Multiplayer

Depending on the title, enjoy online or local multiplayer with up to four players. Team up with friends and fight your way through each adventure together.

Modern Quality-of-Life Features

A variety of convenient features make the games accessible to both newcomers and veteran players. Difficulty options, cheat functions, and save/load anywhere allow you to jump back into the action whenever you like.

Additional features include built-in move lists, one-button special move shortcuts, and fully customizable key mapping, making every game easier and more comfortable to play.

Multiple Display Modes

Choose from a variety of display options, from classic arcade-style screen filters to crisp high-definition visuals, and enjoy the games in the style you prefer.

※ Language can be selected from the main menu, allowing you to play each title in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, or Korean.

Included Games

《Knights of Valour: Super Heroes》

《Knights of Valour Plus》

《Knights of Valour 2 - Nine Dragons》

《Oriental Legend》

《Oriental Legend Spooky》

※《Oriental Legend》 / 《Oriental Legend Spooky》 does not support Japanese language in-game.

※《Oriental Legend》 does not support Korean language in-game.

《Martial Masters》

《Demon Front》

《The Gladiator》

※ The Japanese version of 《The Gladiator》 does not include background music.
